blocks.text: 2p orbital ki electron density s orbital ki tarah kurrawi taur par mutawazan (symmetric) taqseem nahi hoti. Is ke bajaye p orbital ke kisi ek mehwar par do lobes hote hain. Teen p orbitals apne mehwaron ke mutabiq px, py aur pz kehlate hain.

blocks.prompt: Magnetic quantum number ki teen qeematon ki wajah se p orbital ke teen rukh hain. Is ki daleel dein.
blocks.explanation: p subshell ke liye l = 1, to m 2l + 1 = 3 qeematein -1, 0 aur +1 leta hai. Har qeemat khala mein ek rukh hai, aur teen orbitals do-lobe wale px, py aur pz hain jo teen amood mehwaron par hain.

items: p orbital ke ek mehwar par do lobes hain; px, py aur pz teen mehwaron par hain, m ki har qeemat ke liye ek.
